questions.question: A alone can do a piece of work in 30 days. B alone can do the same work in 60 days. If they work together for five days, What fraction of the work will be left?
questions.solution:
A can do a work in 1 day = 1/30 part

⇒ A can do a work in 5 days = 5/30 = 1/6 part

⇒ B can do the same work in 1 day = 1/60 part

⇒ B can do the same work in 5 days = 5/60 = 1/12 part

⇒ Work done by A and B together in 5 days = 1/6 + 1/12 = 3/12 = 1/4 part

⇒ Remaining work = 1 - 1/4 = 3/4 part

∴ Remaining work is 3/4 part.

questions.question: The downstream speed of a boat is 14 km/h. The upstream speed of the boat is 10 km/h. In how much time can it cover 72 km in still water?
questions.solution:
Speed of the boat in still water = (Downstream speed of boat + Upstream speed of boat)/2

⇒ Speed of the boat in still water = (14 + 10)/2 = 12 km/h

⇒ Time = Distance/speed

⇒ Time = 72/12 = 6 hours

∴ The boat can cover 72 km in 6 hours in still water.

questions.question: What is the ratio of the inradius and circumradius of a square?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/523ec78dc523c7bfacb5005341345eb0fb71f145b973f76959459748a404fe68.png] 

Let the side of the square be a.

Inradius of square = side of square/2 = a/2

⇒ Circumradius of square = diagonal of square/2

⇒ Circumradius of square = (√2 × side of square)/2 = (√2a)/2

⇒ Inradius of square : Circumradius of square = (a/2) : (√2a/2) = 1 : √2 

∴ The ratio of the inradius and circumradius of a square is 1 : √2.

questions.question: The diagonal of a square is 24 cm. What is its perimeter?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diagonal of square = 24 cm.

**Formula Used:**

The diagonal of a square = side × √2

**Calculation:**

⇒ 24 = side × √2

⇒ Side = 12√2 cm

Perimeter of the square = 4 × side = 4 × 12√2 = 48√2 cm

**∴ The perimeter of the square is 48√2 cm.**

questions.question: The difference in selling price of an article when it is sold at 20% profit and 18% loss is Rs 570. If it is sold at 12% loss, then what will be the selling price of the article?
questions.solution:
**Short Trick:**

(20 + 18)% of CP = 570

CP = 1500

Required SP = 1500 × (100 - 12)/100 = Rs. 1320

**Detailed Solution:**

Let the cost price be 100x.

⇒ Selling price when sold at 12% profit = 100x × 120% = 120x

⇒ Selling price when sold at 18% loss = 100x × 82% = 82x

⇒ The difference in selling price when sold at 20% Profit and when sold at 18% Loss = 570

⇒ (120x - 82x) = 570

⇒ 38x = 570

⇒ 100x = 1500

⇒ Selling price when sold at 12% loss = cost price × (100 - 12)%

⇒ Selling price when sold at 12% loss = 1500 88% = Rs. 1320

∴ Selling price at 12% loss will be Rs. 1320.

questions.question: The average weight of 14 children is 22 kg. If the weight of the teacher is also included, the average weight becomes 23 kg. What is the weight of the teacher?
questions.solution:
The average weight of 14 children = 22 kg

⇒ Total weight of 14 children = 22 × 14 = 308 kg

⇒ The average weight of 14 children and a teacher = 23 kg

⇒ Total weight of 14 children + weight of teacher = 345

⇒ 308 + weight of teacher = 345

⇒ Weight of teacher = 37 kg

∴ Weight of teacher is 37 kg

questions.question: After giving 20% discount on an article a shopkeeper earns 30% profit. Marked price is what percent of cost price?
questions.solution:
Let the marked be 100x

⇒ Selling price = marked price × (100 - discount)%

⇒ Selling price = 100x × (100 - 20)%

⇒ Selling price = 80x

⇒ Selling price = cost price × (100 + profit)% 

⇒ Selling price = cost price × (100 + 30)% 

⇒ 80x = cost price × 130%

⇒ Cost price = 8000x/130 = 800x/13

⇒ Required % = [marked price/ cost price] × 100 = [100x/(800x/13)] × 100 = 1300/8 = 162.5%

∴ Marked price is 162.5% of cost price.

A car can cover a distance of 18 km in 24 minutes. The speed of a bus is twice that of the car. In how many minutes can the bus cover a distance of 135 km?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 18 km

Time = 24 minutes

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

A car can cover a distance of 18 km in 24 minutes.

⇒ Speed of the car = 18/(24/60) = 45 km/h

⇒ The speed of a bus = 2 × Speed of the car

⇒ The speed of a bus = 2 × 45 = 90 km/h

⇒ Time taken by bus = 135/90 = 3/2 hours = 90 minutes

**∴ The bus covers a distance of 135 km in 90 minutes.**

questions.question: A is 15% more than B. B is how much percent (correct up to two decimal places) less than A?
questions.solution:
Let the value of B be 100x

⇒ A = 100x × 115% = 115x

⇒ Required % = [(A - B)/A] × 100 = (15/115) × 100

⇒ Required % = 13.04%

∴ B is 13.04% less than A.

questions.question: The monthly income of A and B are Rs. 12000 and Rs 8000 respectively. The ratio of their monthly expenditures is 5 : 3. If they save an equal amount per month, then how much money does each of them save per month?
questions.solution:
Let the monthly expenditures A and B be 5x and 3x.

⇒ Saving of A = Saving of B

⇒ 12000 - 5x = 8000 - 3x

⇒ 2x = 4000

⇒ x = 2000

⇒ Now saving of A = 12000 - 5x = 12000 - 10000 = Rs. 2000

⇒ Now saving of B = Rs. 2000

∴ A and B save Rs. 2000 per month.

questions.question: If x + y + z = 360 and x : y : z = 4 : 3 : 2, then what is the value of y + z - x?
questions.solution:
The value of x = [x/(x + y + z)] × total 

⇒ The value of x = [4/9] × 360 = 160

⇒ The value of y = [3/9] × 360 = 120

⇒ The value of z = [2/9] × 360 = 80 

⇒ y + z - x = 120 + 80 - 160 = 40

 ∴ The value of (y + z - x) is 40.
